full_name: Khalil Gibran Muhammad | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2016–2017 History Suzanne Young Murray Professor Harvard Kennedy School
bio: Khalil Gibran Muhammad is a professor of history, race, and public policy at the Harvard Kennedy School and the Suzanne Young Murray Professor at the Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study. His academic work focuses on racial criminalization and the origins of the carceral state.
